panels.title: Link detail (each direction is measured from its own site)

options.content: ### How to read the map **Lines** are the tailnet links between sites, coloured by health (worst of the two directions): - **green** normal - **orange** loss above 2%, or latency more than twice its own 1-day norm - **red** loss above 10%, or the link is down **Markers** are the sites: green = nothing wrong there, orange = failing checks or firing alerts at that site. Hover a line or marker for numbers. Latency is compared with each link's *own* normal, so a long link (Portland to Florida, ~90 ms) is not flagged for being long. Underlying data: ping mesh (10 pings a minute from every site), plus the Network dashboard for the full matrix.
